subject.title: fix(thread-ownership): bound 409 response read and preserve cancel semantics

question: Should maintainers land this narrowly scoped 409 cancellation fix, or use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101968 as the canonical landing path because they also want its mention-cache cap?
rationale: Both open PRs repair the same delivery invariant, while the competing branch adds a separate cache-retention policy; choosing the permanent scope is a maintainer ownership and merge-risk decision rather than a correctness defect in this patch.

options.title: Land the narrow repair
options.body: Merge this PR for the bounded authoritative-409 fix and reconcile or close the overlapping conflict-handler portion of the broader PR.

options.title: Use the broader repair
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101968 as canonical only if the 2000-entry mention-cache cap is also approved and its combined scope is preferred.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow repair
recommendation.body: Merge this PR for the bounded authoritative-409 fix and reconcile or close the overlapping conflict-handler portion of the broader PR.
